input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including book, token, user. The platform provides capabilities for authentication, book, logout. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage book records, so that I can track and organize book data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage token records, so that I can track and organize token data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
